status: Independent model review completed: 6 accepted/revised candidates, 4 concrete linguistic uncertainties; not native-certified.
method: Direct translation in Tifinagh with explicit uncertainty and backtranslation; existing catalogue is terminology context, not proof of correctness.

rows.value: AN Paint ⴷⴰ ⵉⵃⵟⵟⵓ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵡⵔⵎⴰⵏ…
rows.backtranslation: AN Paint is saving the image automatically…
rows.review_note: Ongoing da + intensive saving predicate, not queued/completed. Image is a contextual paraphrase of the drawing draft; does not imply export. No placeholders.

rows.backtranslation: AN Paint is performing the operation…
rows.review_note: Changed iskar to intensive isskar after da to express ongoing work, not completed action. No saved/queued claim.
Standalone ready-state predicate, not imperative or completed saving claim.

rows.english: Please wait for the current operation.
rows.value: ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵏⵏⴽ, ⵔⴰⵊⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵙⵎⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵀⵍⵜ ⴰ.
rows.backtranslation: Please wait until this operation finishes.
rows.review_note: Please + wait until this operation finishes. Feminine t- agrees with tamhlt. Does not instruct cancellation.
Current wording literally asks for a small size; comparative smaller is not explicit. Do not claim semantic equivalence yet. Needs a confident comparative revision, rather than release unchanged.

rows.value: ⵙⵎⵔⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵡⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵓⴳⴳⴰⵔ ⵏ 0.
rows.backtranslation: Use a target dimension greater than 0.
rows.review_note: Strict greater-than-zero condition preserved; not zero-or-more. Target-dimension terminology is a contextual noun phrase rather than a claim of an officially standardized term.

Replaced ghars, which does not mean at least, with one image or more. This preserves minimum one and allows multiple images. IRCAM Asinag 19 documents ghars as chez lui / egorge, not a minimum quantifier.

The sequencing intent is clear, but adruz is not confidently established as a UI touch imperative. Do not approve this verb simply because it is Tifinagh. A UI tap/touch term needs correction or linguistic verification.

rows.value: %1$s: %2$s. ⴰⴷⵔⵓⵣ ⵃⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎⴷ ⵢⴰⵏ ⵓⵟⵟⵓⵏ.
rows.review_note: Both positional string placeholders retained exactly and in source order. Enter a number does not restrict input to integers. Same unresolved adruz touch-verb issue as ui_tap_an_image_first; placeholders alone do not establish linguistic correctness.

Use language of asnkm has the right option structure, but asnkm=device is not confidently established. Do not silently replace device with computer or telephone because Android device-language also covers tablets. Needs term correction/verification.

review_sources.supports: ghars is not an at-least quantifier; IRCAM homonymy table gives chez lui / egorge.
